normal and tumor samples, I still want to get the similay reault. Can

normal tumor

>cdf_n <- getCdf(cesFln)
>gi <- getGenomeInformation(cdf_n)
>units <- getUnitsOnChromosome(gi,chromosome=c(1:23))
>unitNames <- getUnitNames(cdf_n,units=units)
>theta <- extractMatrix(cesFln,units=units)
>rownames(theta) <- unitNames
>index_t <- match(paires[,"tumor"],getNames(cesFln))
>index_n <- match(paires[,"normal"],getNames(cesFln))
>tumor <- theta[,index_t]
>normal <-theta[,index_n]
>CN <- log2(tumor/normal)

On Thu, Oct 30, 2008 at 2:25 PM, haile...@gmail.com
<haile...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> Hi,

> Because I want to get the copy number of all samples with all snp id,
> so I followed the "calculating raw total copy number manully" steps.
> my question: 1 Did I do the right steps?

> 2If I analyzed the unpaired snp with different
> normal and tumor samples, I still want to get the similay reault. Can
> I follwing the same steps ? But how to calculate the log2 ratio.

I'm not sure what your question/problem is: The log2 CN ratio for a
specific locus is defined as:

M = log2(theta_i/theta_R)

where 'theta_i' refers to the theta for sample i and 'theta_R' to the
theta for the reference sample (R). In an paired analysis, you pick
theta_R to be the value for the normal sample. In a non-paired
analysis you have to decide what to use for theta_R, but typically it
is a robust average of the pool of available samples. Some people
just want to use normals for this, some want to use both tumor and
normals. In either case, if your set of reference samples is in
AffymetrixCelSet 'cesRef' then you calculate the reference signals as:

ceRef <- getAverage(cesRef);

This reference can then be treated as if it was a hybridized sample
(indeed aroma.affymetrix don't "know" the difference). FYI, you can
also extract the complete JxI theta matrix from 'cesRef' and do
rowMedians() on that to achieve the same, but be more memory efficient
and the result is persistent over time (it will not have to be
recalculated when you restart R).

Hope this helps

Henrik
